Two separate sexual assault incidents reported involving minors

In Mumbai's Powai area, a 15-year-old girl was allegedly sexually assaulted by five men, all of whom have been arrested. Separately, in Goa, a 16-year-old girl was allegedly sexually assaulted at a crime branch office. A police officer and a female aide have been booked in connection with the Goa incident.
